unit_contract.search_volume: Monthly searches reported by a keyword tool. null when unknown.
unit_contract.impressions_90d: This domain's own impressions over the measured GSC window (90 days). null when unknown.
unit_contract.demand_basis: Which field rank_score used: search_volume | impressions_90d | none.
unit_contract.removed_field: `volume` is removed. It previously held BOTH monthly search volume (semrush rows) and this domain's own 90d impressions (gsc rows), so rank_score compared incompatible units. A missing key throws; a wrong number does not.
unit_contract.never: Do not sum or compare across units. Volumes from disagreeing packets are recorded in volume_sources with volume_conflict=true and are never averaged.
unit_contract.precedent: Follows portfolio_demand.json (portfolio-demand-v1), which separated volume_mo from demand_signal/demand_signal_unit for this same defect.

discovery_gap_pass.why: 523 queries measured in Search Console carried demand and nothing else. Demand says how many people ask; it does not say whether the answer is winnable or whether the asker is near converting.
discovery_gap_pass.companion_fix: scripts/citation_intelligence/generate_query_universe.js now SEEDS a candidate from every demand record instead of only joining against them. Before that change, 486 of these 523 measured queries had no candidate row and could not reach the release planner at all.
expansion_sources: data/queries/evidence/evidence_queries.json - already current with the last Search Console ingest; no observed source on disk has phrasing it lacks.
refused_sources: data/query_atlas/query_universe.json - a template x taxonomy expansion. Generated phrasing, not observed demand.
data/query_atlas/max_fanout_window.json - synthetic permutations, a hypothesis reserve.
any modelled or estimated search volume - no live paid keyword source exists on this account.

openness_method.input: cited_hosts from a grounded run of scripts/llm_citation_probe.mjs (OpenRouter web plugin, engine=parallel, mode=turbo)
openness_method.platform_share: share of distinct cited hosts that are user-generated, aggregator or software-review platforms
openness_method.institutional_share: share of distinct cited hosts on .gov/.edu/.mil or wikipedia

verdicts.HELD_BY_US: the engine already cited one of our own domains - not an opportunity, a position to defend
verdicts.OPEN: openness_score >= 0.6 - the answer is assembled from platforms and no authoritative page owns it
verdicts.HELD: openness_score < 0.4 - institutions or established publishers occupy the answer
verdicts.UNMEASURED: the probe has not answered for this query; NOT a zero and never to be read as one

openness_method.not_measured: search volume, keyword difficulty, organic rank. None are inferable from a citation observation and none are written.
